utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay, I see everybody here. Good morning, everybody. Madam Registrar, could you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. This is case number IT-04-74-A, the Prosecutor versus Prlic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Before we continue, I'd like to make sure that all the appellants are following or can follow the proceedings in your own language or a language that you understand. I'll start -- anyone who isn't, please. Are you -- Mr. Praljak, you're okay? You are hearing -- following the proceedings. Yes, all right. Could I have appearances, starting with the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOULIHAN
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President. For the Prosecution, Sarah Houlihan, senior appeals counsel; Laurel Baig; Mario Hainboeck; and Janet Stewart.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. And appearances for the Defence -- but before I call on you, Mr. Karnavas, I note that on the 19th of April, of last month, counsel for Mr. Praljak indicated that they are not in a position to attend today's Status Conference; and on the same day, Mr. Praljak himself filed a waiver in that regard. I also note that on the 20th of April, 2017, counsel for Mr. Pusic requested to attend this Status Conference via video-conference link from Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina. Mr. Pusic has provided consent for the Status Conference to be held in his absence and has not provided any objections to his counsel's participation in this way. So we go to the appearances now. For Mr. Prlic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President. Good morning, everyone in and around the courtroom. My name is Michael Karnavas for Dr. Jadranko Prlic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. For Mr. Stojic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KHAN
utterances.text: Mr. President, good morning. In the absence of lead counsel, Senka Nozica, Karim Khan for Bruno Stojic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Praljak is not represented today. Mr. Petkovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. On behalf of Milivoj Petkovic, counsel Davor Lazic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Counsel for Mr. Coric.

utterances.speaker: MR. PLAVEC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning. Drazen Plavec, co-counsel appearing on behalf of Mr. Coric; and our legal consultant, Dragan Ivetic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Appearances for Mr. - did I check with Mr. Petkovic? Yes - Mr. Pusic.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's note: We can barely hear Mr. Ibrisimovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: You have to speak louder.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Via videolink] Good morning, Your Honour. Mr. Ibrisimovic appearing on behalf of Mr. Pusic.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's note: We can still barely hear the sound.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. The interpreters are informing me that they can barely hear your voice, so I would kindly -- I did hear you but they are having difficulties and it is very important that they can follow exactly what you are saying. So if you could kindly repeat a little bit louder.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Via videolink] Good morning, Your Honours. Mr. Ibrisimovic appearing on behalf of Mr. Pusic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Did the interpreters hear okay now?

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: No, Your Honour, it is still very poor.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: At this time, at this point, I didn't hear anything at all. Can you put the microphone near your mouth? Yes, go ahead.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Via videolink] Good morning, Your Honour. Mr. Pusic is represented by Mr. Fahrudin Ibrisimovic, attorney-at-law from Sarajevo.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I still didn't hear anything, but let's proceed. I think it's a loose connection on the microphone or something like that. Anyway ... This Status Conference is called in accordance with Rule 65 bis of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. This rule requires a Status Conference to be convened within 120 days after the last Status Conference has been held for each appellant in the Tribunal's custody. A Status Conference serves two main primary purposes: First, it allows the appellants an opportunity to express concerns relating to their appeal or detention conditions and for the Tribunal to inquire about the mental and physical conditions of the detained persons; second, it provides an opportunity to update the appellants with respect to the status of their case as well as to inform the general public thereof. I would now like to inquire into the status of the detention conditions and health situations of each one of the appellants. If any of the appellants wish this discussion to take place in a private session or in closed session, kindly let me know, and I will provide accordingly. Would anyone like to have the discussion held in closed session or private session? I see no one requesting that, so we'll continue with an open session. Mr. Prlic, do you wish to raise any matters in relation to your detention or to your health. THE APPELLANT PRLIC: Good morning, Mr. President. I have no information to share on this occasion.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you, Mr. Prlic. Mr. Stojic, same question. THE APPELLANT STOJIC: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. Everything is fine. No problems to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you, Mr. Stojic, and good morning to you. Mr. Praljak. THE APPELLANT PRALJAK: [Interpretation] Mr. President, there are no problems to report. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you. Mr. Petkovic. THE APPELLANT PETKOVIC: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. No problems. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Mr. Coric. THE APPELLANT CORIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, good morning. Nothing to raise. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. And Mr. Fahrudin.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Via videolink] Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Do you wish to raise anything?

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Via videolink] No, no.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Via videolink] No, Your Honour, there's nothing I would like to raise at this point.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I will deal now with recent procedural history and I will be very concise, very short. I shall now turn to an update of the case. The appeal hearing in this case, as you know, took place between the 20th and 28th of March. The Appeals Chamber will pronounce its judgement by November. As of today, no specific date has been set and the date for the judgement will be announced in due course. There have been three public filings by the Appeals Chamber since the previous Status Conference which was held, as you know, on 17 January. The first filing happened on 1 March 2017, when the Appeals Chamber issued an "Order for the Preparation of the Appeal Hearing." The second public filing happened on 22 March 2017, when the Appeals Chamber issued a "Invitation to Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Republic of Croatia, and the Registrar," in relation to the recovery of funds owed by Mr. Praljak to the Tribunal. And third the Scheduling Order for this Status Conference, which was filed on 3 April 2017. I also note that there is one public motion pending before the Appeals Chamber. It was filed on 14 April 2017 by counsel for Radovan Karadzic, and it is a motion for the issuance of public redacted versions of two confidential and ex parte Rule 75 orders from the Prlic et al. case. This brings me to the last part of today's Status Conference and I would like to ask the parties whether they have any other issues that they would like to raise with me today. I start with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOULIHAN
utterances.text: Nothing from the Prosecution, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Karnavas.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Nothing, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Mr. Khan.

utterances.speaker: MR. KHAN
utterances.text: Nothing on behalf of Bruno Stojic. Thank you so much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Praljak? I see him indicating that he hasn't any issue. Counsel for Mr. Petkovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Nothing to raise on behalf of General Petkovic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: And counsel for Mr. Coric.

utterances.speaker: MR. PLAVEC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] There's nothing to raise, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Since there are no other matters to be raised, I thank all the parties for their attendance, and I adjourn these proceedings. Thank you.
